summary: Brera Holdings PLC (Solmate Infrastructure) filed a Form 6-K disclosing termination of its proposed acquisition of RockawayX a.s. The non-binding term sheet, entered in December 2025, contemplated consideration of 25 million Class B ordinary shares initially, plus up to 62 million contingent earn-out and up to 20 million trading-price-condition shares (pre-reverse split basis). The Board decided to discontinue after RockawayX's actual results and explanations were found unsatisfactory. Material inconsistencies in EBITDA and financial information were cited. The company is assessing potential claims. No advisor named. Watch for potential litigation and alternative strategic evaluation.
